summary: Physical scarcity and AI infrastructure demand remain real, but 5% long yields, tighter policy expectations and weak breadth are raising the price of capital. The winning side of the barbell is funded, cash-generative scarcity; the losing side is crowded duration without near-term cash conversion.

signals.implication: Raise the valuation and free-cash-flow hurdle across TTWO, TSLA and crowded infrastructure multiples.

signals.signal: Fed hike probability about 93–95%; BOJ expected to tighten
signals.implication: Do not front-run a dovish reversal. Wait for the actual decision and long-end reaction.

signals.signal: Saudi pipeline/Yanbu disruption, rerouting through alternative ports; US crude inventories +7.1m barrels
signals.implication: Scarcity remains investable but is now two-sided. Hold quality exposure; do not chase headline spikes.

signals.signal: No broad capex cancellations; power/grid backlog remains intact
signals.implication: GEV, VST, ETN and PWR remain research priorities on retests, not momentum buys.

signals.signal: DRAM pricing expected +13–18%; scarcity could persist through 2027 and beyond
signals.implication: MU enters the selective queue, but only after consolidation because price already discounts strong execution.

signals.signal: Slower bank-loan growth framed as structural new normal
signals.implication: Track total financing mix and bond/equity substitution; do not read loan growth alone as a clean collapse signal.

signals.signal: Bullion remains resilient despite high yields
signals.implication: Structural hedge thesis is intact; tactical entry still depends on real-yield and dollar stabilization.
